import pytest
from main import get_most_frequent_category

test_cases = [
    ({"groceries": 3, "electronics": 1}, "groceries"),
    ({"groceries": 1, "electronics": 3}, "electronics"),
]

validation_cases = [
    pytest.param({}, None, marks=pytest.mark.validate),
    pytest.param({"groceries": 2, "electronics": 2}, "groceries", marks=pytest.mark.validate),
]

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input1", "expected_output"), test_cases + validation_cases
)
def test_get_most_frequent_category(input1, expected_output):
    print("\n---------------------------------")
    print(f"Inputs: {input1}")
    result = get_most_frequent_category(input1)
    print(f"Expected: {expected_output}")
    print(f"Actual:   {result}")
    assert result == expected_output
